title: Final boss beats override the arc boss themes with the generic 'boss' song
repro: Penguin p5_spire (moon, talk spire) and gangster g5_president (uptown): effects have both boss_card and music:'boss'. Story._apply runs boss_card first (GameMap.boss_card -> boss_track('dark_crystal')='boss_penguin' / boss_track('president')='boss_gang', DangerMusic.boss_started holds it) and then fx.music plays 'boss' (story.gd:407), so the final fight of each arc plays the generic boss song instead of the arc theme built from Tom's melody. DangerMusic then keeps 'boss' (it is in BOSS_TRACKS). Probe: right after p5_spire effects wanted()='boss' while m.boss_music='boss_penguin'.
fix: Remove "music": "boss" from p5_spire and g5_president effects (boss_card already picks the right song), or make Story._apply skip fx.music when fx has boss_card. story.json is hand-edited (no generator found).

title: Penguin final fight: music ping-pongs between 'finargle' and 'boss_penguin' as you move between Fennimore and the Dark Crystal (probe-confirmed)
repro: p5_spire spawns dark_crystal at (22,14) and finargle_elder (has a gift -> bossy -> DangerMusic.is_boss) at (19,16), ~60 px apart. DangerMusic.assess picks the NEAREST boss; boss_track_for(finargle_elder) returns PER_BOSS 'finargle' (checked before the 'already playing a boss track' rule), and tick's 'w == tier, track differs, w == 4' branch switches song whenever the nearest boss changes. Walking/rolling between the two flips 'finargle' <-> 'boss' every few seconds with 0.6 s crossfades. CONFIRMED by probe tools/probe_c6_13_final.gd (moon, p5_spire effects applied, player moved next to each boss every ~2.4 s): wanted() went boss -> finargle, then finargle/boss_penguin alternating with the nearest boss (log /tmp/c6_13/p3.txt).
fix: Hysteresis for tier 4: keep the current boss song while its boss (_boss_wr) is still alive and engaged/within BOSS_R; only switch when that boss falls or leaves. Alternatively prefer the boss that owns a boss_card (meta from GameMap.boss_card) over a PER_BOSS secondary. Add a danger_music_test case with two bosses.

title: Ending beats: the 'meadow' calm lasts about 3 s (probe-confirmed), the ending choice plays over the area song, and the victory sting fires after the ending conversation
repro: Kill the Dark Crystal / President: DangerMusic.boss_ended crossfades to area_track() ('moon' / 'uptown') and queues j_victory in 2 s (_sting_t). Within 0.5 s Story.tick starts p5_win / g5_win; Dialogue pauses the tree, so the whole ending conversation and the revert/shatter or free/take choice play over the plain area song, and the sting timer is frozen. When the dialogue closes, effects play 'meadow', then ~1.5 s later the j_victory sting blares over it (even after the sad 'shatter'/'take' choice), and DangerMusic's calm re-ask (AREA_EVERY 3 s, area_track) swaps 'meadow' back to 'moon'/'uptown'. Net: moon -> meadow -> moon in ~4 s right after the climax. CONFIRMED by probe tools/probe_c6_13_hold.gd (applies p5_win on moon / g5_win on uptown, then plays on): wanted() 'meadow' at 0.25 s -> 'moon' at 3.5 s; 'meadow' -> 'uptown' at 3.0 s (log /tmp/c6_13/hold3.txt).
fix: Add a story music hold: Story fx.music sets e.g. Music.story_hold = track (cleared on scene change) that DangerMusic's calm branch respects (do not re-ask area_track while held). Start the beat's music BEFORE its lines for ending beats (e.g. new fx key 'music_first' or 'music' in the beat itself, applied in Story.play before _play_lines). Cancel _sting_t when a story beat starts (or play the sting at once in boss_ended when the boss has a story_flag), so no jingle lands after the ending choice.

title: queue_after('credits') is never cleared, and a finished play-once track leaves DangerMusic silent
repro: Epilogue._ready plays ending_* (67 s) and queue_after('credits'); most players tap through the slides faster, Epilogue._close plays area_track() but Music._after stays 'credits'. The next ONCE track to finish (merkitty_song once it is wired, a replayed ending) then starts 'credits' unasked. Separately, Music._on_finished does nothing when _after is empty, so _current stays e.g. 'credits'; DangerMusic.tick returns early while mu._current is in Music.ONCE (danger_music.gd:98), so if the slides stay up past ending+credits (~4 min) or any ONCE track ends on a live map, no area song and no combat music play again until a map change. The plan's 'title returns after the credits' (AUDIO-PLAN.md) is not implemented either.
fix: Music.play(): clear _after whenever a non-ONCE track is asked for (or Epilogue._close calls queue_after('')). _on_finished: if _current is ONCE and _after == '', set _current = '' (or play a sensible fallback: 'title' inside the Epilogue, area song otherwise) so DangerMusic resumes. Epilogue: queue 'title' after 'credits' if the slides are still up.

title: merkitty_song (sung lullaby, 150 s, made for the merkitty scenes) is never played
repro: grep: 'merkitty_song' appears only in Music.ONCE/_standin and music_map_test. The p4_merkitties beat (lake: 'The merkitties swim a circle around you, singing...') plays over the lake song; the Merkitty Pool's night 'sing' animation (farm.gd ~168) is silent. AUDIO-PLAN D8 says this vocal track is for 'the merkitty verse scenes'.
fix: p4_merkitties: start merkitty_song before its lines (needs the music-before-lines hook from the ending finding) and queue the area song after (Music.queue_after(area_track) + the _on_finished fallback fix). Optionally a quiet positional loop/excerpt near the Merkitty Pool at night via Ambience spot. Penguin arc only.

title: Story-critical songs are streamed but never prefetched: the ending, credits and final-boss themes start late on the phone build
repro: ending_penguin/ending_gangster (~720 KB), credits (1.9 MB), boss_penguin, boss_gang, boss, finargle, festival are in data/music_stream.json. PREFETCH lists hold none of them. Epilogue._ready plays the ending: Music.play() keeps the song already playing (the farm morning tune after the p5/g5_epilogue beat) until the download lands, which is exactly what epilogue.gd's comment tries to avoid; same for boss_card on the final bosses and the town on festival day. When nothing is playing yet (arriving on a new map), Music._standin picks 'farm' for any outdoor song, so the first visit to the moon / uptown tower for the finale can open on the farm tune until 'moon'/'uptown' download.
fix: Add a situational prefetch: Music.prefetch(list) called when flags final_started / tower_open / final_done are set (Story._apply) for boss themes + ending + credits, and on festival mornings for 'festival' (house.gd morning or SleepReport). Prefetch goes through the existing _prefetch queue. Include 'moon' (penguins, after the teleporter quest) and 'uptown' (gangsters, at tower_open) in the situational prefetch; give _standin a darker packed fallback for boss/finale maps if one exists.

title: Heart scenes at 2/4/6/8 hearts have no audio framing; j_birthday is rendered but never used
repro: Hearts.talk shows the '<name> ♥n' toast and plays the scene with no cue; only ♥10 plays j_heart, and only AFTER the scene. Birthday gifts play j_heart/j_gift (game_state.gd:1914); audio/sfx/j_birthday.ogg (ACE kit) is referenced nowhere (j_morning and j_skill are also unused, for other scopes).
fix: Hearts.talk: play a soft j_heart (or a new heart_scene cue) as the toast appears for every milestone, duck music slightly (Music.set_duck(-4)) during the scene and restore after; keep the full j_heart for ♥10. game_state.gd gift sfx: 'j_birthday' when is_birthday(npc) and gain > 0.

title: Festival song plays in town all 24 hours of festival day and overrides night/rain; one song for all four festivals
repro: GameMap.area_track: id=='town' and festival_today() != '' returns 'festival' before the night/rain checks, so at 1 am, 6 am and after the stalls close (town.gd open 8-18) the folk band plays to an empty plaza; Ambience already limits the festival crowd to 8:00-23:00 (ambience.gd:187). The Lantern and Star festivals (night/winter moods) get the same 116 bpm fiddle reel as the Egg Festival.
fix: area_track: festival only between 8:00 and 23:00 (match Ambience), else fall through to night. Optional (needs Tom/credits): festival_night or per-festival variants (lantern/star) as ACE renders, picked by GameState.festival_today().
audio_needed: optional: festival_night (lanterns/star, slower, music-box/strings) ACE render
needs_tom: Want a night variant of the festival song for the Lantern and Star festivals (about 4 ACE credits)?

title: Dialogue lines cannot carry a sound or music cue, so cutscene audio can only change after a whole beat
repro: Dialogue._next reads text/who/pic/mood/choice/keep only (dialogue.gd ~272-285); Story effects (music, sfx, shake) run after all lines (story.gd:185). So 'The merkitties ... singing', 'The sky fills' (lantern festival), the Dark Crystal's arrival, the President turning his chair, all play over whatever song was on, and every music change lands after the last line.
fix: Dialogue._next: honour optional line keys "sfx" (Music.sfx) and "music" (Music.play, slow fade e.g. 2.0) when the line shows, before typing starts (also when skipping: apply the last music key among skipped lines so the state is right). Then use them in story.json for p5_spire/g5_president (boss song on the reveal line), p4_merkitties (merkitty_song), p5_win/g5_win (calm after the choice), and town.gd lantern line.

title: Festival events are nearly silent: no festival-start cue, no egg-hunt fanfare, lantern fireworks fire after the scene and at any hour
repro: town.gd _festival_event: egg hunt start and the last egg ("All the eggs!" +200) play no jingle beyond give()'s pickup; lantern: 'fireworks' sfx plays after the dialogue closes, not on 'The sky fills.', and the event runs at noon as well as at night; star festival gift has no cue. AUDIO-PLAN G6 planned a festival_start stinger (not cut; no j_festival file) and 'festival games/prize' sounds.
fix: Play j_confirm on 'Go!' and j_treasure (or quest_done) on the last egg; lantern: move the fireworks to the 'The sky fills' line (line sfx key) and, if before 18:00, word it as lanterns only (no fireworks sound) or open the lantern event from dusk; star festival: j_gift on the box. Optional: cut a festival_start cue from an existing ACE render (tools/ace_kits.py) and play it on the first town arrival of festival day (town.gd:119 toast).
audio_needed: optional festival_start stinger (cut from an existing render, no credits)

title: Chapter title cards and the final 'morning after' beat have no musical moment
repro: Story.play shows chapter_title as a plain toast (story.gd:167) with no sting; j_region exists for region arrivals but chapters get nothing. p5_epilogue / g5_epilogue (sleep trigger, 'Morning. The field...' / 'Rain again...') play over the farm's seasonal song, then the Epilogue switches abruptly to the ending track.
fix: Play a short cue on chapter title cards (j_region or j_page; or the arc theme's first bars via a 'arc_<arc>' short cut). For the epilogue beats start the ending track (or title_musicbox) at the first line (line music key) so the morning scene flows into the slides; Epilogue._ready then finds it already playing (Music.play returns early on the same track).

title: Boss victory sting waits out any post-boss dialogue and lands after it, stacked on other jingles
repro: DangerMusic._sting_t counts down only in tick, which returns while the tree is paused (danger_music.gd:78). Dialogue pauses the tree, so any boss whose death opens a conversation (story beats after boss flags, Colony._restore 'crystal restored' lines, ending beats) plays j_victory ~1.5 s AFTER the conversation ends. Colony._restore also plays quest_done at the kill and plays m.music_track itself, so a colony win gives quest_done -> dialogue -> j_victory.
fix: In boss_ended: if a Dialogue opens before the sting fires (check Dialogue.instance(tree).active in tick while paused, or a static 'cancel_sting()' called from Dialogue.say / Story.play), drop the sting (the scene owns the moment). Or play the sting immediately with the wind-down when the boss carries story_flag/colony_boss meta. Colony._restore: skip quest_done (the sting covers it) or call DangerMusic.boss_ended(m, false, false) before its own cue.

title: Every story beat ends on the same bright quest_done fanfare, even sombre or ominous ones
repro: 17 beats carry effects.sfx 'levelup', which Story._apply turns into quest_done (story.gd:386). It plays right after lines like p2_finn_locket ('turns toward the water so you won't see his face'), p1_grump_truth ('They think the meadow has wolves.'), g4_kid (Flame's board), and g4_sasha's cliffhanger ('a shadow the size of a doorway falls over yours'), where a victory fanfare undercuts the moment.
fix: Give beats a tone: sfx 'j_page' or 'j_heart' (soft) for tender beats (p2_finn_locket, p2_catkins, p4_bell_rung, p5_bell_help, g4_kid), 'alert'/a low sting or none for ominous ones (g4_sasha, p1_grump_truth); keep quest_done for recruit/joins (g3_*). Story._apply should pass other sfx names through unchanged (it already does for non-'levelup').
audio_needed: optional: a short low 'ominous' sting cut from an existing render (boss/marked) for cliffhanger beats

title: Both arcs' climaxes resolve to the pastoral 'meadow' song, on the moon and in the gangster tower
repro: p5_win (moon) and g5_win (uptown tower lobby) both use effects.music 'meadow' after the ending choice. For the gangster arc a fiddle-and-fields meadow tune in a marble tower after 'Take the city' / 'Pull the stone out' clashes with the noir arc; for both arcs the ending tracks built from Tom's arc melodies (ending_penguin / ending_gangster, or title_musicbox) fit the moment better.
fix: Use 'title_musicbox' (both arcs) or the arc's ending track for p5_win/g5_win (if the ending track is used here, the Epilogue's Music.play of the same track becomes a no-op, so either restart it or pick title_musicbox here). Needs the story music hold from the ending finding so it is not replaced after 3 s.

title: title_musicbox (music-box 'Dreams', packed in the web build) is never played
repro: grep: 'title_musicbox' appears only in tools/music_map_test.gd. It is not in data/music_stream.json, so every web load downloads it with the pack, yet AUDIO-PLAN F5 meant it for the save screen and creator, and it would suit the ending beats / the end of the credits.
fix: Play it on the save-slot and creator pages (title.gd) and use it after 'credits' in the Epilogue (queue_after chain) or for p5_win/g5_win; otherwise add it to the streamed list (tools/music_stream.py) so it stops weighing on the pack.

title: Community farm grand opening: the 'festival' song is cut back to 'countryside' ~3 s after the speech
repro: community_farm._reveal on the last stage plays Music 'festival' before the Mayor/Sal opening speech. The dialogue pauses the tree (DangerMusic frozen), but as soon as it closes DangerMusic's calm branch re-asks area_track() every AREA_EVERY (3 s) and crossfades to the farm's 'countryside', so the celebration song covers the speech only and the market's first moments sound like any other day. Same root cause as the ending-beat finding (no way for a scene to hold a song).
fix: Use the story music hold proposed for the ending beats (e.g. Music.hold(track, secs or until scene change), respected by DangerMusic calm re-asks); hold 'festival' for ~60-90 s or until the player leaves the community farm. Alternatively GameMap.area_track on community_farm returns 'festival' on the opening day (flag set in _reveal).

title: Arc building intros (ArcIntro) play with no cue; note-form intros sound like any chat
repro: ArcIntro.first (first use of a Hideout/Chrome Clinic/Merkitty Pool etc.) just calls m.say(script_for(id)); no sting on the reveal, and the 'A note is tucked under the corner' variant gets the same talk blip as speech ('Note' speaker pitch).
fix: Play j_page when the note variant opens (and skip the talk blip for who 'Note' / '' via a Dialogue line flag), and j_region (or a soft quest_done) when a spoken arc intro opens a new building for the first time.

title: Closing the ending slides cuts the ending song with the normal 0.9 s crossfade
repro: Epilogue._close calls Music.play(gm.area_track()) with the default FADE 0.9 s, so tapping B or reaching 'Thank you for playing' chops ending_penguin/ending_gangster (or credits) mid-phrase into the farm tune.
fix: Epilogue._close: Music.play(gm.area_track(), 3.0) (slow fade), and if the ending track is still in its first ~60 s, consider letting it play out under the farm (queue_after(area_track) and only switch on _on_finished) since DangerMusic already leaves ONCE tracks alone.

title: The town bell beats have no bell sound: 'The bell rings... one note goes out over the fields' is silent, and so is its echo in the final fight
repro: p4_bell_rung (quest_done alder_gold) opens with 'The bell rings. Twenty-one years of rust come off it in one note...' and p5_bell_help (moon, final fight) with 'From very far away... a bell. One note, twenty-one years of rust, and then voices under it.' No bell sfx exists (audio/sfx has only shop_bell and sled_bells) and the beats only play quest_done after the lines. This is a key emotional callback in the penguin arc. The bell is the town's recurring motif (heart scenes: alder 6, theo 6/8, marlowe 6, ivy 6/8, sel 8, pip 10 'a law that the bell rings every day'; gangster ending: 'a very old bell... rings once anyway').
fix: Import a single deep town/church bell toll (CC0, via tools/cc0_import.py MAP + cc0_sources.json, then tools/sfx_soften.py) as sfx 'town_bell' plus a filtered distant copy 'town_bell_far' (low-pass + reverb in sfx_soften or ffmpeg). Play 'town_bell' on the first line of p4_bell_rung and 'town_bell_far' on the first line of p5_bell_help via the per-line sfx key (dialogue finding); replace their trailing quest_done with j_heart. Optional follow-through: after p4_bell_rung, an Ambience spot sound of the bell at noon in town (and faint on the farm), which pays off Pip's ♥10 line.
audio_needed: town_bell (one deep bronze bell toll, ~4-6 s ring-out) and a distant/filtered version; CC0 or an ACE kit cut

title: Story lines describe sounds the game never plays (the first howl, the stone breaking, the city bell in the gangster ending, the humming locket)
repro: p1_howl (farm, the arc's first scare: 'Lightning, with no thunder after it. Then a howl: not a wolf. Lower...') has no sfx at all; g5_win branch 0: 'It comes loose with a sound like a cork' / 'you break it with your heel... a very old bell that was never going to ring again rings once anyway' (silent); p2_locket: 'It hums very faintly, like it's trying to remember a tune.' (silent). Existing sounds fit several: roar (pitched down / far), glass, the bell proposed in the town-bell finding.
fix: With the per-line sfx key: p1_howl line -> 'roar' (or a new 'howl_far', low and distant) ; g5_win 'cork' line -> 'pop'/'uncork' if present else 'glass' soft, 'break it with your heel' -> 'glass', bell line -> 'town_bell_far'; p2_locket -> a soft music-box hum (cut 2 s of title_musicbox as sfx 'locket_hum'). Penguin p5_win 'Make the heart' line could take j_heart.
audio_needed: optional: howl_far (deep distant howl), locket_hum (2 s cut from title_musicbox, no credits)
